subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should OpenClaw close primary-agent browser tabs at ordinary task completion, and which run-owned marker plus terminal event should define a temporary tab without closing user-owned pages?
rationale: Current code has the cleanup primitives, but the requested default changes user-visible browser ownership and can discard useful browser state if the boundary is too broad.

options.title: Add run-owned task cleanup
options.body: Define a run-owned temporary-tab marker, close only those tabs at the chosen primary-agent terminal event, and keep existing idle/cap/reset cleanup as fallback.

options.title: Keep idle and reset cleanup only
options.body: Leave the current 120-minute idle sweep, tab cap, reset, cron, and subagent cleanup behavior as the safe default and rely on explicit user/model tab closure for task-level hygiene.

options.title: Make it opt-in first
options.body: Introduce task-completion cleanup behind an explicit policy flag or debug-safe rollout before making it the default.

recommendation.title: Add run-owned task cleanup
recommendation.body: Define a run-owned temporary-tab marker, close only those tabs at the chosen primary-agent terminal event, and keep existing idle/cap/reset cleanup as fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on browser tab cleanup and the relevant product-safety boundary.
